supportingText: Start with a 15-minute Free First Visit. Adults can choose to train that day. Sandy must confirm the class first. You can choose sparring too. This means live practice with a matched partner. You can pause or end a round at any time. Youth use their own visit and class plan.
goalMappingClothing: For a visit, wear your own day clothes. To train, wear clean sports clothes. Follow Sandy's class and arrival plan.

generalPath.name: Free First Visit
generalPath.nextStep: After the visit, adults may choose a coach-confirmed class that day or plan a later class

youthCombinedPath.name: Youth first visit + coached class
youthCombinedPath.scope: Only the specialized youth booking workflow

steps.title: Reserve Your Free First Visit
steps.subtitle: First visit before class
steps.description: Ask for your first visit. Choose Kids, Teens, or Adults. Share what times suit you.

steps.title: Meet Sandy for your first visit
steps.subtitle: One-visit starting plan
steps.description: Meet Sandy. See the room and learn the rules. Talk about your goals and plan your class.

steps.title: Choose the right first class
steps.subtitle: Matched, coached first class
steps.description: Adults can choose to train after the visit that day. Sandy confirms the class first. You can also choose a later day. Youth follow their own class plan.

steps.title: Free First Class
steps.subtitle: Coached Learning Experience
steps.description: Try a coached first class at your pace. Adults can choose live partner practice. You can pause or end a round at any time.

challenge.name: The Sandy Challenge
challenge.publicDescription: Try a timed round with Sandy. A belt holds his arms at his sides. He uses movement to defend. You both agree on rules first. Either of you can say "pause" to end the round. Sandy releases the belt when the round ends. You choose if you take part.

publicCopy.overview: Start with a 15-minute Free First Visit. Adults can choose to train that day. Sandy must confirm the class first. You can choose sparring too. This means live practice with a matched partner. You can pause or end a round at any time. Youth use their own visit and class plan.
publicCopy.clothing: For a visit, wear your own day clothes. To train, wear clean sports clothes. Follow Sandy's class and arrival plan.
publicCopy.adultTraining: Meet Sandy for your first visit. Then choose to train that day or come back for class. Sandy confirms the plan with you.
publicCopy.sparring: Sparring is live practice with a partner. You can choose to try it on day one. Sandy matches the partner and pace. You can pause or end a round at any time.
publicCopy.challenge: Try a timed round with Sandy. A belt holds his arms at his sides. He uses movement to defend. You both agree on rules first. Either of you can say "pause" to end the round. Sandy releases the belt when the round ends. You choose if you take part.
